Maria Nguyen: quick alert: bench flagged degraded long-form recall for a new bring-up of aurora9b-int6 vs int8 on multi-turn GTN priming (history-heavy). saw ~2.4% drop recall@5 when history_tokens>2500.
Liam O.: can you paste the summary numbers?
Maria Nguyen: n=2500 long-history slice. recall@5 int8=0.768, int6=0.744 (delta -0.024 abs, -3.12% rel). p50 lat: int8=125ms, int6=95ms. cost/1k: int6=$0.15, int8=$0.22.
Priya Singh: product: what's the expected customer impact if 10% of tokens go to int8 fallback for these requests? baseline traffic ~80M tokens/mo.
Maria Nguyen: rough calc: 80k * $0.15 = $12,000 if all int6. all int8 = 80k * $0.22 = $17,600. 10% int8 => 72k*$0.15 + 8k*$0.22 = $10,800 + $1,760 = $12,560 -> +$560/mo (~4.7%).
bench-bot: run recorded run_id=3333, commit=4a9b1c, artifacts s3://bench/aurora9b/3333/. variants: int6,int8,int6-kvfp16-last2.
Liam O.: hypothesis: int6 quant noise accumulating in KV leads for deep history. quick ablation: keep KV float16 for last 2 layers. can you run and share diffs?
Maria Nguyen: running ablation now. repro:
```
python eval.py --model aurora9b --quant int6 --slice long-history --kvcache-precision float16 --kvcache-last-layers 2
```
Priya Singh: product is fine with a small canary if ablation doesn't fully recover. prefer a staged rollout: 1% -> 5% -> 10% for long-history routing to int8.
Maria Nguyen: plan: finish ablation today, post diff. if residual gap >1.5% we'll propose 2% canary to int8 for long-history. ops-bot: canary window please.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-06-01T01:00:00Z -> 2026-06-01T04:00:00Z. canary_id=canary-aurora9b-3333. Owner=@Maria Nguyen.
